channel.title: AI Daily Watch: Azure AI & Microsoft Foundry
channel.description: Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Foundry Agent Service, Azure AI services and major Azure platform updates.

item.title: Microsoft Foundry blog outlines closed-loop evaluations for production agents
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft published a guide to a closed-loop process for improving production agents, combining continuous evaluation and Application Insights signals with trace-based datasets, Agent Optimizer, regression tests, and CI/CD gates. The workflow also describes canary rollouts and promotion or rollback decisions, giving teams a way to evaluate agent quality and cost while controlling changes reaching users.

item.title: Kling, LTX, and MiniMax video models enter public preview in Microsoft Foundry through fal partnership
item.description: Microsoft (fal): Microsoft and fal are bringing Kling v3 Pro, LTX-2.5 Fast, LTX-2.5 Pro, MiniMax H3 Max, and MiniMax H3 Max Turbo to Microsoft Foundry in public preview. The post includes per-second pricing for the models, with rates varying by model, resolution, and (for Kling) audio options.

item.title: Microsoft Foundry extension for Azure Developer CLI reaches GA at version 1.0
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft made the `microsoft.foundry` extension bundle for Azure Developer CLI generally available at version 1.0. It adds agent setup and local testing to the `azd` workflow, with agent and deployment configuration kept alongside application code.

item.title: Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3.1 Pro comes to Microsoft Foundry
item.description: Microsoft (Moonshot AI): Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3.1 Pro, an open-weight model for agentic work with text and image understanding and up to a 1-million-token context window, is coming to Microsoft Foundry. Microsoft lists prices of $2.30 per million input tokens, $0.23 per million cached input tokens, and $11.50 per million output tokens.

item.title: Azure AI Agents azd extension 1.0.0 adds local A2A execution and skill optimization
item.description: Microsoft: Version 1.0.0 of Microsoft's Azure AI Agents azd extension adds terminal-only local A2A 0.3 agent execution, including JSON or streaming output. It also adds trace-driven skill optimization and reporting, with generated skills requiring deliberate inspection rather than being automatically applied or deployed.

item.title: MAI-Image-2.6 and MAI-Image-2.6-Flash reach general availability in Microsoft Foundry
item.description: Microsoft: MAI-Image-2.6 and MAI-Image-2.6-Flash are now generally available in Microsoft Foundry. The announcement highlights multi-reference editing with up to five images for MAI-Image-2.6 and lists starting prices: $5/$8/$38 per million text-input/image-input/image-output tokens for 2.6, and $1.75/$2.50/$19 for Flash.
